description: Search Viator by keyword, browse a destination or activity category, collect experience details by URL, or extract traveler reviews. All data is public and needs no Viator account.

category.description: Category for mode=byCategory. Legacy Viator labels are accepted and mapped to the closest live category.
category.title: Activity category

destination.description: City or region for mode=search, byDestination or byCategory. Examples: Paris, Rome, New York City.
destination.title: Destination

maxDurationHours.description: Keep experiences whose shortest listed duration is at most this many hours.
maxDurationHours.title: Maximum duration (hours)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of experience records to return. Review mode uses maxReviewsPerExperience instead.
maxItems.title: Max experience records

maxPrice.description: Keep experiences whose from-price is at or below this amount in the listing currency (USD by default).
maxPrice.title: Maximum price

maxReviewsPerExperience.description: Maximum number of traveler reviews to return for each experience URL (mode=getReviews).
maxReviewsPerExperience.title: Max reviews per experience

minDurationHours.description: Keep experiences whose shortest listed duration is at least this many hours.
minDurationHours.title: Minimum duration (hours)

minPrice.description: Keep experiences whose from-price is at or above this amount in the listing currency (USD by default).
minPrice.title: Minimum price

minRating.description: Keep experiences rated at or above this value (0 to 5).
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minReviewCount.description: Keep experiences with at least this many traveler reviews.
minReviewCount.title: Minimum review count

mode.description: What to collect: keyword search, destination browse, category browse, experience details, or traveler reviews.
mode.title: Mode

searchQuery.description: Keyword(s) for mode=search. Examples: Eiffel Tower tour, pasta making class, Seine cruise.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Order of the returned experience records. Filters are applied first, then this order, then maxItems is applied.
sortBy.title: Sort by

startUrls.description: Viator experience, destination or category URLs. Used by getExperience, getReviews, byDestination and byCategory.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

title: Viator Tours, Activities & Reviews Scraper Input
